reports.title: A. O. Smith Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: As a result of the announced sale of a majority interest in the China business, which represents a strategic shift in the Company’s portfolio, the Company expects to classify the China business as held for sale and report it as discontinued operations beginning in the fourth quarter of 2026, with prior periods recast accordingly. Third quarter 2026 results presented in this release include the China business. Upon closing of the transaction, the Company expects to deconsolidate the China business and account for its retained 19% interest under the equity method. The Company will also review its segment reporting structure during the fourth quarter of 2026.
Accordingly, the Company has updated its full-year 2026 guidance to exclude the China business for all of 2026.
